en.headline: Education Bureau says 56.5 per cent of Primary 1 applicants offered discretionary places
en.dek: A record high success rate as total applications fall to 32,104 for September 2027 entry, with results due on Monday.
body: The Education Bureau announced on Friday that 18,148 children out of 32,104 applicants have been offered discretionary Primary 1 places at government and aided schools for the 2027 academic year.

The success rate of 56.5 per cent is up 4.2 percentage points from last year and the highest in more than two decades, the bureau said. Applicant numbers fell by 5,477, or about 14.6 per cent, from the previous cycle.
Of those allocated places, 8,270 qualified because a sibling already attends the school or a parent works there. The remaining 9,878 were selected under the points-based system.

Parents who have activated the Primary 1 e-platform can check results from 10 a.m. on Monday, 23 November. Others may visit the school they applied to between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. the same day with the parent copy of the application form.

Successful applicants must register at the school during office hours on 25 or 26 November. Failure to do so without prior arrangement with the school will be treated as forfeiture of the place, the bureau said.

zh.headline: 教育局公布小一自行分配學位成功率56.5% 創逾二十年新高
zh.dek: 申請人數跌至32,104人，18,148人獲派位，結果下周一公布，家長須於25或26日註冊。
body: 教育局周五宣布，明年九月入讀官立及資助小學的小一自行分配學位，共有32,104名兒童申請，其中18,148人獲派位，成功率達56.5%。
成功率較去年上升4.2個百分點，為逾二十年來新高。申請人數按年減少5,477人，跌幅約14.6%。
獲派學位者中，8,270人屬有兄姊在該校就讀或父母在該校任職的類別，其餙9,878人則按計分辦法準則分配。
已啟動小一入學電子平台帳戶的家長，可於下星期一（11月23日）上午十時起透過平台查閱結果。其他家長可於當日上午九時至下午五時，攜同申請表家長副本前往所申請小學查閱。
獲派位的家長須於11月25日或26日學校辦公時間內前往學校辦理註冊。如未能在指定日期註冊而又未事先與學校聯絡，將被視作放棄學位，教育局表示。
